price_basis_note: open/high/low/close are Yahoo's split-adjusted prices (auto_adjust=False), not the as-traded historical tape; a backtest must state which basis it executes on
adjustment_note: adj_close is Yahoo's split-and-dividend-adjusted close; adj_close / close is Yahoo's dividend adjustment factor, applied to open/high/low to derive adjusted OHLC
date_note: dates are the exchange's trading dates (US/Eastern), not UTC
